snippet.title: Evidence the Last Report gameplay (PC Game, 1996)
snippet.description:
Introduction and gameplay for Evidence the Last Report, PC game produced by Microids in 1996 - http://www.squakenet.com/download/evidence-the-last-report/2197/
Intro and early gameplay of Evidence the Last Resort, showing the apartment and interacting with every single object. A solid and very complex puzzle game which will prove to be a challenge for all the fans of the genre. .
Played through modern Windows machine.
Recorded with original sound.
